python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img1 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0001.png')
img6 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0006.png')

# Lamp shade (yellow cone):
# In obs_0001 vs obs_0006
yellow1 = (img1[:, :, 0] < 150) & (img1[:, :, 1] > 180) & (img1[:, :, 2] > 180)
yellow6 = (img6[:, :, 0] < 150) & (img6[:, :, 1] > 180) & (img6[:, :, 2] > 180)

print('Lamp shade in img1 bbox:', np.where(yellow1))
print('Lamp shade in img6 bbox:', np.where(yellow6))

# Lamp base (blue) in img1 vs img6:
blue1 = (img1[:, :, 0] > 150) & (img1[:, :, 2] < 50)
blue6 = (img6[:, :, 0] > 150) & (img6[:, :, 2] < 50)

y1, x1 = np.where(blue1)
y6, x6 = np.where(blue6)
print(f'Blue object img1: x=[{np.min(x1)}, {np.max(x1)}], y=[{np.min(y1)}, {np.max(y1)}]')
print(f'Blue object img6: x=[{np.min(x6)}, {np.max(x6)}], y=[{np.min(y6)}, {np.max(y6)}]')
"
